text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Yasuda Kinen. After arriving at the racecourse, I spent every spare moment checking on Almond Eye's condition and caring for her body.
choice_data_list: —Your heart rate is a little high.
—Your heart rate is a little high.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Well...
it's right before a race, so of course it'd go up a bit, right?
choice_data_list: Even compared to before a normal race.
Even compared to before a normal race, you know.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Uh!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Geez, you know full well!
I'm just really, really looking forward to it!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Ever since the Victoria Mile, you and I have been tuning up together just for today..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I just want to run with all my might—I want to win!
I'm just itching to get out there!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!
You knew all along, didn't you?
choice_data_list: Shall we take a look at how your muscles move next?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Geez... All right~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Completely focused on facing Almond Eye.
Shutting out entirely all the chatter around her
that she would usually worry about—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
If she runs normally, Ai-chan will win!
Ai-chan is the strongest~♡

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I totally want her to win!
'Cause, 'cause if she wins today... hehehe~♪

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if she runs normally, sure, but...
My concern is that the race interval is just too short.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Is it really that short?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah. There are even rumors that Ai-chan collapsed after the Oaks... I don't think she's built super tough or anything.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder how that will affect things...
Though under normal circumstances, I'd bet on Ai-chan too."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! You watched the Victoria Mile,
right? Ai-senpai isn't that fragile.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I'm still so frustrated!
Frustrated for a whole 100 miles!
I wanted to run today toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Wait, we were just talking normally, but...
Whaaaaaat!?!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――I'll check every detail to ensure Almond Eye
can deliver beyond normal... her absolute best performance. And then...
choice_data_list: ...All right, it's going to be fine!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Well then, I'm heading out!
choice_data_list: Stop, stop, your hair's all messed up

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No way!
Where is it? Fix it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Did it get cleaner?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hey, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Make sure you watch the race closely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Today, I know for sure—I'm stronger! Even stronger than usual!
